summary: Iteration 5 testing: role-based scoping (member vs owner/admin) + My Work page. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py runs 13/13 pass — owner sees full data (10 customers, /api/dashboard/stats 200, /api/my-work populated); freshly invited member sees EMPTY customers/invoices/expenses/tasks/leads; member creating a customer sees exactly 1 of their own while owner sees the same plus all workspace ones; products/suppliers remain shared (equal counts); member POST /api/team/invite returns 403; /api/my-work for member returns empty tasks/leads. Frontend Playwright: owner login OK, sidebar-nav-my work present and routes to /my-work; stat cards mywork-open-tasks=7, mywork-open-leads=6, mywork-overdue=1; mywork-tasks/mywork-leads/mywork-activity all render owner data. Owner Customers list = 10 rows. Team invite in Settings > Team generates temp_password; invited member logs in successfully; member's Customers/Invoices/Expenses/Tasks/Leads lists all show 0 rows (scoping works end-to-end through UI); member's Settings > Team hides invite form and remove-member buttons (invite-submit absent, 0 remove btns) — privilege gating enforced client-side; member My Work shows 0/0/0 with 'No open tasks / No active leads / No activity yet' placeholders. Cleanup: test invitees removed via DELETE /api/team/{id}.

ui_bugs.issue: Confirmation dialog body reads 'undefined will lose access to this workspace.' — the member name variable is not interpolated (likely passing member.full_name where field is member.name, or vice-versa). Functionality still works (remove succeeds), but text is broken.

action_items: Fix 'undefined will lose access to this workspace.' message in TeamTab remove-member ConfirmDialog — interpolate the member's display name correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: member_scoped filter in crud.py appears to work correctly for list endpoints, but confirm that direct GET-by-id (e.g. GET /api/customers/{id}) also enforces created_by check for members — otherwise a member could enumerate IDs and read/update/delete an owner's record. Not verified in this iteration's tests; recommend adding a test that a member cannot GET/PUT/DELETE another user's record by id.
server.py /api/my-work groups tasks by 'assigned or created' — ensure the assigned filter uses the owner's user_id (not email/name) to avoid mis-matches when users are renamed.
TeamTab remove-confirm string bug (see frontend_issues) — indicates a small prop/field-name mismatch; low risk but user-visible.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter5 flows (My Work owner+member, role scoping across 5 modules, invite gating hidden for members, member end-to-end login and empty lists)

test_credentials: Owner: aniruddh.samarth@gmail.com / Admin@12345. Members created dynamically via /api/team/invite (unique email per run).
seed_data_creation: None permanent. All TEST_* invited members were removed via DELETE /api/team/{id} after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter5 role-scoping (member sees only own records; products/suppliers shared) is fully green backend and frontend. Sidebar testid is exactly 'sidebar-nav-my work' (lowercased, space preserved). Invite result renders temp password on the line after the email separated by a '/' line — parse by taking the first alnum token after the email line. Dashboard endpoint is /api/dashboard/stats (not /api/dashboard). Only cosmetic bug found: remove-member confirm dialog shows 'undefined will lose access to this workspace.' — needs a small string interpolation fix in TeamTab.js.
rca of the issue: TeamTab remove ConfirmDialog: the confirmation description likely references a field like `${selected.name}` while the team member object exposes the name under a different key (e.g. `full_name` or `display_name`), yielding 'undefined'. Fix: log the object passed to setConfirmMember and use the correct key, or add a fallback `${m.name || m.full_name || m.email}`.
